items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: Conte Candoli summed it up. ... So Conte Candoli, he was asked about the vibrato thing. And you know what Harry told him one time?

ctx.x: Conte Candoli summed it up. Now the book that was written on Harry, Trumpet Blues I was interviewed by the author, God, for a week. When that book came out he called me and apologized. He says, “Fred, you’re the first individual I interviewed about Harry James that looked at him on a different level you know, like, instead of just funny stories and this stuff happened.” And that book is good at the beginning but there’s other things in the book, it was like how, it was the negative part of Harry James instead of…
This was the vibrato he did with his hand?
